senses.gloss: m. (חצב) [cutter,] a shrubby plant, with deep and straight roots, used for hedges to mark boundaries, prob. cistus.
units: B. Bath. 55ᵃ המצר והח׳ וכ׳ a landmark (stone &c.) and the ḥazab form a legal boundary &c.
<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 14:16">Tosef. Sabb. XIV</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 15:8">XV</cite>), 8; Y. ib. XVIII, 16ᶜ bot; Bab.
ib. 128ᵃ מטלטלין את הח׳ וכ׳ you may (on the Sabbath) handle the (cut) ḥ., because it is food for gazelles.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kilayim 1:8">Kil. I, 8</cite> <he>חצוב</he> (Ar. <cite ref="H01493"><he>חצב</he></cite>).—Pl., v. <cite ref="H01508"><he>חֲצוּבָה</he> I</cite>.
